h2_offered_and_selected.error: peer selected h2; this helper implements HTTP/1.1 only
h2_offered_and_selected.note: exercised by calling exchange(http2=True) directly, which is the only way to reach this branch

no_alpn.note: no ALPN selection is treated as HTTP/1.1 per RFC 7301 fallback; this is not a downgrade from a selected protocol

before_fix_evidence.interpretation: no ALPN selection; HTTP/1.1 fallback per RFC 7301 is legitimate

defect.description: exchange() accepted an http2 flag but wrote an HTTP/1.1 request line unconditionally after the handshake. No ALPN check existed. Had the adapter ever been opened with that flag against a peer selecting h2, an HTTP/1.1 request would have been fed into an h2 channel.
defect.severity: latent: the shipped runtime calls fetch() with http2=False, so the client never offers h2 and the h2 branch was unreachable through the supported path
defect.why_not_observed_before_fix: with http2=False the adapter offers http/1.1 only; a peer offering only h2 yields no selection, which is the RFC 7301 fallback case, not a downgrade

guard: HTTP/1.1 is written only when ALPN is empty or http/1.1; h2 or any other selection raises before any byte is sent
